Translating these priorities into impactful joint programming is critical. We therefore call upon entities to include a chapter in their strategic plans that defines their comparative advantages within the UNDS based on their mandates. The QCPR reinforces the leadership role and responsibilities of the Resident Coordinators within UN country teams. Full support for the RC system is key. We emphasize that enhancing UNDS entities' capabilities in innovation, data analytics, digital transformation, strategic oversight, and behavioral science is a core commitment of the Pact for the future. We call on entities to adopt and implement system-wide strategies for disability inclusion, gender equality, and youth empowerment, incorporating measurable indicators for progress. Efforts to prevent sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment are non-negotiable.
